public_declarations.full_header:
theorem N01Properties.exists_discriminantIncrement_strip_joint_growth
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (j : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hcell : ∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (j m))
    (l h : ℕ → ℝ) (hl : ∀ m, C.left m < l m)
    (hh : ∀ m, h m < C.right m) :
    ∃ K : ∀ m, SmoothDirections
      (sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε ×ˢ (Ioo (l m) (h m) ×ˢ univ))
      (fun z : (StateDirections S × ℝ) × PolarPoint =>
        (((originalCoefficients D S C (liftSectorParameter S C z.1)).b z.2 ^ 2 -
            (originalCoefficients D S C (liftSectorParameter S C z.1)).a z.2 *
              (originalCoefficients D S C (liftSectorParameter S C z.1)).c z.2) -
          ((originalCoefficients D S C (C.referenceState, 0)).b z.2 ^ 2 -
            (originalCoefficients D S C (C.referenceState, 0)).a z.2 *
              (originalCoefficients D S C (C.referenceState, 0)).c z.2)) /
          T.H (T.sample (j m)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)),
      ∃ B L : ℕ, base ≤ B ∧ loss ≤ B ∧
        UniformWeightedJointGrowth (pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading)
          (fun m => radialE (D.cellIndex (j m))) K B L := by

source_review_notes: Current coefficients come from public originalCoefficient_stripTower and originalCoefficient_strip_joint_growth at the given j,l,h.
Reference towers are the same original towers precomposed with the actual CLM L0(x,y)=(0,y); compAffine_apply preserves every physical slot and kills only parameter slots.
Reference quantitative bounds use original growth at low radius0, unchanged physical point and norm; hence no new low base or material sample.
The normalized increment tower is exactly public199 postcomposition by H(j m)^(-3/4), restricted to the same open strip. The same j/m/physical point is retained.
The literal identity is (b+b0)db/H - c da/H - a0 dc/H = (Delta-Delta0)/H; division is multiplication by an inverse and ring is valid without a new H lower assumption.
Three fixed public weighted multiplication closures choose B1,L1 etc before joint order. B=max Bi, L=max Li. Separate bounds base<=Bi and loss<=Bi are used correctly; loss<=Li is not asserted.
All sums, products and differences are actual SmoothDirections on the original U×V. The final literal discriminant tower is congruent to that same constructed tower; no order-dependent selection.
No private characteristic or sample-bound helper is invoked. No sqrt/inverse discriminant tower or corrected coefficient is silently used.
